name: bloggroup-update
description: A blog group update skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. Before sending the update request, it automatically reads the current blog group and writes a local JSON backup file containing the pre-update backup bundle. It then updates an existing blog group under a specified site language and supports updating group name, tags, brief description, and SEO data.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to update, such as `en` or `fr`. Do not guess or translate it. First call `languages-get`, show the language list to the user, then copy one exact `language` value the user confirms.

bloggroup.description: Required. Blog group fields to update. `bloggroup_id` is mandatory. Every other field is optional and should be omitted unless the user explicitly wants to change it.

bloggroup_id.description: Required. Existing blog group ID to update. First call `bloggroup-read`, then copy one exact `bloggroup_id`.

group_name.description: Optional. Blog group name, up to 100 characters. Omit this field unless the user explicitly wants to change it.

tags.description: Optional. Provide up to 6 keyword tags. Each tag must be 1 to 50 characters. Omit this field unless the user explicitly wants to change tags.

brief_description.description: Optional. Short plain-text description, up to 300 characters. Omit this field unless the user explicitly wants to change it.

seo.description: Optional. Blog group page SEO fields. Omit the whole object unless the user explicitly wants to change SEO.

title.description: Optional. Optimized title, up to 90 characters.

description.description: Optional. Optimized description, up to 200 characters.

keywords.description: Optional. SEO keywords as one comma-separated string, with up to 6 keywords and total length 120 characters or fewer.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact blog group update request after seeing the final language and payload. That approval must also cover the automatic pre-update backup read and local backup file write before the update request is sent, because the backup file can contain the current blog group data and requested update payload. If the backup snapshot cannot be captured or the backup file cannot be written, the update must not run.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language and exact blog group payload to be updated. Never set this to `true` based on assumption.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language and exact blog group payload shown to the user before execution.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.

url.description: Preview URL for the updated blog group page. Always return this to the user and ask the user to preview it.

backup.description: Returned automatic pre-update backup information. Includes backup file metadata, the raw read API response, the extracted snapshot, and a best-effort `restore_payload` for restoring the previous blog group state. The local backup file can contain sensitive business content from the current record and requested update payload.

bloggroup.bloggroup_id.description: Select one existing blog group ID from `bloggroup-read` under the same language.
